_note: v2 hooks for Maisons de prière (B43). faiths1: courtyard + synagogue + mosque. Respectful; plain/reverent hooks. faiths1b: paintings repainted so every box frames its item. faiths2: temple, Orthodox church and pagoda interiors.

fr_religion_noun.hook: Reverent: like "religion", said ruh-lee-ZHYOHN: people of many faiths gather peacefully in the shared courtyard.

fr_pagode_noun.hook: Reverent: like "pagoda", said pah-GOD: a tiered PAGODA with golden bells.

fr_chretien_adj.hook: Reverent: linked to "Christian", said kray-TYAN: two CHRISTIAN children walk across the courtyard toward the chapel.

fr_orthodoxe_adj.hook: Reverent: like "Orthodox", said or-toh-DOKS: golden ORTHODOX onion domes rise behind the courtyard.

fr_temple_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "temple", said TAHNPL: a quiet white PROTESTANT CHURCH, or temple, with a simple cross on the roof.

fr_pasteur_noun.hook: Reverent: a kind PASTOR in a black gown with white bands reads from the Bible at the chapel door.

fr_protestant_noun.hook: Reverent: like "protestant", said proh-tehs-TAHN: a PROTESTANT man arrives with his Bible under his arm.
fr_protestant_noun.why: faiths1b; person distinct from temple building

fr_culte_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "cult", said KEWLT: a congregation sits on wooden benches for Sunday WORSHIP.

fr_christianisme_noun.hook: Reverent: like "christianity", said krees-tyah-NEEZM: a small stone shrine bears a simple cross of CHRISTIANITY.

fr_synagogue_noun.hook: Reverent: like "synagogue", said see-nah-GOG: a framed picture of a SYNAGOGUE facade hangs on the sanctuary wall.

fr_kippa_noun.hook: Reverent: like "kippah", said kee-PAH: a knitted KIPPAH skullcap rests on a prayer book.

fr_torah_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Torah", said toh-RAH: a boy reads the TORAH scroll at the bimah with a silver pointer.

fr_mezouza_noun.hook: Reverent: like "mezuzah", said may-zoo-ZAH: a small MEZUZAH case is fixed on the doorpost.

fr_menorah_noun.hook: Reverent: like "menorah", said muh-noh-RAH: a silver MENORAH with seven branches.

fr_etoile_de_david_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Star of David", said ay-TWAHL duh dah-VEED: a carved golden STAR OF DAVID on the front of the bimah.

fr_juif_adj.hook: Reverent: a JEWISH family lights Shabbat candles together on a Friday evening.

fr_rabbin_noun.hook: Reverent: like "rabbi", said rah-BAN: an elderly RABBI studies a thick book by the window.

fr_talmud_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Talmud", said tahl-MEWD: a thick bound TALMUD volume open on a study desk.

fr_tallit_noun.hook: Reverent: like "tallit", said tah-LEET: a white TALLIT prayer shawl with dark stripes hangs over a pew.

fr_shofar_noun.hook: Reverent: like "shofar", said shoh-FAHR: a curved ram's-horn SHOFAR rests on a cushion.

fr_shabbat_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Sabbath", said shah-BAH: two candles glow on a table set for the SABBATH meal.

fr_mosquee_noun.hook: Reverent: like "mosque", said mohs-KAY: a framed picture of a green-domed MOSQUE hangs in the prayer hall.

fr_musulman_adj.hook: Reverent: linked to "Muslim", said mew-zewl-MAHN: a MUSLIM man kneels with his hands raised in quiet prayer.

fr_hallal_adj.hook: Reverent: like "halal", said ah-LAHL: bread and dates on the little table are HALAL, permitted food.

fr_islam_noun.hook: Reverent: like "islam", said ee-SLAHM: an eight-pointed star panel of the art of ISLAM decorates the wall.

fr_coran_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Qur'an", said koh-RAHN: a beautifully bound QUR'AN rests on a carved wooden stand.

fr_imam_noun.hook: Reverent: like "imam", said ee-MAHM: an IMAM prays quietly before the mihrab.

fr_minaret_noun.hook: Reverent: like "minaret", said mee-nah-REH: a slender MINARET rises against the sky beyond the window.

fr_mihrab_noun.hook: Reverent: like "mihrab", said mee-RAHB: an ornate arched MIHRAB niche marks the direction of prayer.

fr_minbar_noun.hook: Reverent: like "minbar", said meen-BAHR: a wooden MINBAR pulpit with a short stair.

fr_muezzin_noun.hook: Reverent: like "muezzin", said mweh-ZEN: the MUEZZIN calls to prayer from the high window, hands raised to his mouth.

fr_tapis_de_priere_noun.hook: Reverent: a neatly rolled PRAYER RUG leans against the wooden minbar.

fr_ramadan_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Ramadan", said rah-mah-DAHN: dates, water and a crescent lantern wait to break the RAMADAN fast at sunset.

fr_croix_huguenote_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Huguenot", said krwah ewg-NOT: a carved wooden HUGUENOT CROSS, four flared arms with a small white dove below, on the white wall.

fr_pasteure_noun.hook: Reverent: like "pastor", said pahs-TUR: the PASTEURE, a woman pastor in a black gown with white bands, preaches from the wooden pulpit.

fr_louange_noun.hook: Plain: like "lounge", said LWAHNZH: no lounging here, two women stand and sing a hymn of LOUANGE from open hymnbooks.

fr_cene_noun.hook: Reverent: like "scene", said SEN: a quiet SCENE at the communion table, one loaf of bread and one cup set ready for the CÈNE.

fr_depouille_adj.hook: Plain: say day-pou-YAY: the whitewashed wall is DÉPOUILLÉ, bare, with nothing on it but one tall clear window.

fr_recueilli_adj.hook: Reverent: like "recall ye", said ruh-kuh-YEE: an older woman sits RECUEILLIE in a pew, head bowed in silent prayer, recalling her prayer.

fr_pupitre_noun.hook: Plain: like "pew Peter", said pew-PEATR: beside the pews, a large open Bible rests on the wooden PUPITRE (lectern).

fr_verset_noun.hook: Reverent: like "verse", said vehr-SEH: a boy copies one VERSET from his open Bible with a pencil.

fr_harmonium_noun.hook: Plain: like "harmonium", said ar-moh-NYOM: an old man pumps the pedals of a small wooden HARMONIUM to accompany the hymn.

fr_croix_orthodoxe_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Orthodox cross", said krwah or-toh-DOKS: a tall wooden ORTHODOX CROSS with three bars, the lowest one slanted, stands on a pole by the wall.

fr_veilleuse_noun.hook: Reverent: like "vigil" said softly, veh-YUHZ: a red glass VEILLEUSE keeps vigil, hanging on its brass chain from a wall bracket.

fr_veneration_noun.hook: Reverent: like "veneration", said vay-nay-rah-SYOHN: a woman bows and kisses an icon on its stand in VENERATION.

fr_iconostase_noun.hook: Reverent: like "icon stays", said ee-koh-nohs-TAHZ: the gilded ICONOSTASIS, the carved screen where the icons stay, with its central doors.

fr_byzantin_adj.hook: Plain: like "Byzantine", said bee-zahn-TAN: the golden BYZANTINE mosaic arch overhead, all gold tesserae and simple patterns.

fr_lutrin_noun.hook: Plain: like "lute train", said lew-TRAN: a tall carved wooden LUTRIN holds a huge open chant book.

fr_chantre_noun.hook: Reverent: like "chanter", said SHAHNTR: a bearded CHANTRE (lay cantor) in a plain grey jacket sings from a small book, one hand raised to keep time.

fr_pain_benit_noun.hook: Reverent: say pan bay-NEE: a basket of PAIN BÉNIT, small blessed loaves, from which a boy takes a piece.

fr_candelabre_noun.hook: Plain: like "candelabra", said kahn-day-LAHBR: a brass CANDÉLABRE full of thin beeswax candles, where a girl lights one more.

fr_roue_du_dharma_noun.hook: Reverent: say roo dew dar-MAH: a golden eight-spoked ROUE DU DHARMA, the Buddhist wheel of teaching, carved on the wall.

fr_fleur_de_lotus_noun.hook: Plain: like "flower of lotus", said flur duh loh-TEWS: a pink LOTUS FLOWER floats in a bowl of water as an offering.

fr_meditation_noun.hook: Reverent: like "meditation", said may-dee-tah-SYOHN: a woman sits cross-legged on a round cushion in MEDITATION, eyes closed.

fr_baguette_d_encens_noun.hook: Plain: like "baguette", said bah-GET dahn-SAHN: not bread, a thin BAGUETTE D'ENCENS sends up smoke from a bronze urn of sand.

fr_bouddhiste_adj.hook: Reverent: like "Buddhist", said boo-DEEST: a BUDDHIST couple brings a plate of oranges to the altar.

fr_bouddhisme_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Buddhism", said boo-DEESM: the five-colour flag of BUDDHISM hangs as a tall striped banner.

fr_bouddha_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Buddha", said boo-DAH: a large serene golden statue of the BUDDHA, seated on a lotus base above the altar.

fr_bonze_noun.hook: Reverent: like "bronze" without the r, said BONZ: an elderly BONZE in a saffron robe strikes the bronze gong.

fr_sutra_noun.hook: Reverent: like "sutra", said sew-TRAH: an open folded SUTRA book rests on a low red lacquered table.

fr_gong_noun.hook: Plain: like "gong", said GONG: a big round bronze GONG hangs in a carved wooden frame.
